tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create Creative Project
tools.description: Initialize a creative project in SketchMonkey from a design brief and optional Brand DNA.

brief.description: The creative brief or hardware design description.

brandDna.description: Optional Brand DNA rules (palette, tone, forbidden styles).

tools.name: generate_directions
tools.title: Generate Five Art Directions
tools.description: Compile a brief into five distinct, expert-grade creative art directions (Ren, Maya, Zola, Kai, Nova) with palettes, typography, materials, and composition strategies.

brief.description: The creative or product brief to explore.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to associate directions with.

tools.name: select_direction
tools.title: Select Art Direction System
tools.description: Commit one of the five creative directions (Ren, Maya, Zola, Kai, Nova) as the default design system for a project, overwriting any previously selected direction on that project.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.title: Create Multi-Artboard Campaign
tools.description: Generate a full multi-format campaign from a master brief and optional background render. Produces responsive artboards (Poster, Square, Story, Banner, CMF Sheet) with editable text layers.

backgroundUrl.description: Optional SketchMonkey CDN rendered image URL (/cdn/sketchmonkey/...) to use as master artwork.

tools.name: inspect_artboard
tools.title: Inspect Artboard Scene Graph
tools.description: Retrieve the structured layers, typography, copy fields, and layout of an artboard.

tools.name: edit_artboard
tools.title: Surgical Edit Artboard
tools.description: Apply a scoped surgical edit (headline, subhead, body copy, font family, alignment, accent color) to an artboard without altering untouched artwork.

tools.name: apply_brand_dna
tools.title: Apply and Validate Brand DNA
tools.description: Save Brand DNA rules (palette, fonts, tone, forbidden styles) for a project, overwriting any previous Brand DNA rules on that project, and validate copy/briefs against them.

validateContent.description: Optional text to check for forbidden rule violations.

tools.name: generate_variants
tools.title: Generate Copy & Typography Variants
tools.description: Create controlled variations of headlines, copy, or typography styles for an artboard.

tools.name: get_artboard_export_metadata
tools.title: Get Artboard Export Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve saved artboard dimensions, format identifiers, and available background image URLs. This tool returns artboard metadata only; it does not render or compose finished PNG or PDF files.

artboardIds.description: IDs of saved artboards to retrieve export metadata for.

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get Job Status
tools.description: Poll the progress of an asynchronous render or export job.

jobId.description: Job ID returned by render_concept or render_video.

tools.name: render_concept
tools.title: Render Design Concept (Legacy)
tools.description: Initiate an industrial design, hardware, product, vehicle, or spatial concept render with SketchMonkey. Supports locking a non-human product/vehicle/space reference via subjectModelId or @handle. Returns a jobId to poll.

subjectModelId.description: Optional non-human design reference ID or @handle (e.g. 'valletta-gte', 'aether-pulse', 'chrono-monolith').

subjectVariantId.description: Optional variant/trim ID on the selected design reference.

tools.name: list_subject_models
tools.title: List Saved Subject References
tools.description: List available non-human design references (products/objects, vehicles/cars, architectural spaces, and stylized non-human mascots) including starter references and saved account references with their @handles, design traits, and variants. Real-person human likenesses and sensitive personal data are excluded.

tools.name: save_subject_model
tools.title: Save Subject Reference
tools.description: Create or update a saved subject reference with identity traits and motion notes for use in image and video prompts. This saves reference data; it does not train an AI model or guarantee visual consistency. Only non-human design categories ('object', 'car', 'space', 'character', 'creature') are supported; never submit real-person facial/voice data or sensitive personal information.

id.description: Optional reference ID when updating an existing custom reference.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to bind this reference to.

name.description: Product, vehicle, or space display name (e.g. 'Valletta GT-E', 'Chrono-01', 'Aether Pulse').

tagline.description: Short product or brand positioning tagline.

identityLock.description: Authoritative product/vehicle/spatial design specification (structural geometry, materials, finish, silhouette, lighting; never real-person facial/biometric data).

immutableTraits.description: Specific product or material design traits to preserve across prompts.

voiceAndMotion.description: Camera motion, turntable pacing, or mechanical articulation notes for video generation.

heroImageUrl.description: Optional owned SketchMonkey CDN reference image URL (/cdn/sketchmonkey/...).

tools.name: render_video
tools.title: Render Video Turnaround with Camera Controls
tools.description: Generate an industrial design video turnaround or product clip with fine-grained cinematic camera controls (360° Orbit, Cinematic Push-In, Heroic Pull-Out, Lateral Pan, Vertical Tilt, Crane Arc, Locked Tripod, Drone Spiral), camera angles (Eye Level, Low Hero, High Studio, Top-Down, Isometric, Macro), pacing, and lens framing. Supports text-to-video or animating an existing concept render into a 3D turnaround.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the product, object, or scene to animate.

referenceImageUrl.description: Optional SketchMonkey CDN URL (/cdn/sketchmonkey/...) of an existing concept render to turnaround.

subjectModelId.description: Optional non-human design reference ID or @handle to lock product/vehicle/space traits in video.

subjectVariantId.description: Optional variant/trim ID for the selected design reference.

tools.name: get_camera_presets
tools.title: Get Video Camera Controls & Presets
tools.description: List all available cinematic camera motions, angles, pacing dynamics, and lens framing options with prompt directives and curated presets for video turnarounds.

tools.name: get_render_status
tools.title: Get Render Job Status (Legacy Alias)
tools.description: Retrieve the current status of an image or video render job by jobId. Returns progress and, when complete, available output URLs; returns an error when the job is unavailable. This is a compatibility alias for get_job.

tools.name: enhance_prompt
tools.title: Enhance Design Prompt with CMF
tools.description: Enrich an informal product description with Color, Material, Finish (CMF) taxonomy, authentic parting lines, and lighting.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.title: Get Account Status & Quota
tools.description: Check authentication status, current user identity, active subscription tier (Free, Chimp, Gorilla, Silverback), and remaining daily generation quota for image and video.
